title: Schéma directeur stratégique du système d'information de santé du Gabon 2017-2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé publique et de la Population
why_not: A 2017 plan that expired in 2022: not a current plan, and its statement that the SNIS budget line was removed is outside the governance window; the gap is the plan, which the PNDS 2024-2028 (lead 6) answers.
